# CreatePort

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Creates a port: something callers Call() and a server receives on.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x04` SVC_CREATE | `OBJECT_PORT (2)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Handle CreatePort(void);
```

**Registers:** `() -> r0 port handle or error`

## Returns

A port handle with all permissions, or a negative error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_NOMEM`](../errors.md#err_nomem) | Out of kernel memory, or the caller's handle table is full. |
